source_pool_spelling: Disakisperma dubium (Kunth) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow — green sprangletop; older Leptochloa dubia (Kunth) Nees

decisions.action: Retain existing single canonical D. dubium learner concept; no rename or new card.
Preserve as historical search alias, not a separate species.
Keep Leptochloa dubia observations under the existing accepted concept only after specimen/photo identity review; do not duplicate.
Historical alias; name equivalence does not independently certify individual observations.

Do NOT confuse this Steudel pro-synonym with separately treated Disakisperma obtusiflorum (Hochst.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow, transferred to Cypholepis obtusiflora in 2026. Require author-sensitive mapping.

decisions.accepted_name: Disakisperma dubium (Kunth) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow remains in Disakisperma
decisions.action: POWO/WCVP page still lists four Disakisperma species; Peterson et al. (2026) recognize Disakisperma as monotypic and transfer the other three species to Cypholepis. D. dubium name is unchanged in both. Document discrepancy; do not rewrite genus lessons, family modules, unrelated taxa or canonical species.

source_comparison.POWO_WCVP_as_checked: Accepted D. dubium (Kunth) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow. POWO genus Disakisperma currently lists D. dubium, D. eleusine, D. obtusiflorum and D. yemenicum (four species).
source_comparison.Peterson_et_al_2026: Peterson, Romaschenko, Snow & Herrera-Arrieta (PhytoKeys 279:1–16; published 2026-08-26) use eight plastid markers and nuclear ITS, resurrect Cypholepis for C. eleusine, C. obtusiflora and C. yemenica, and treat Disakisperma as monotypic (D. dubium).
source_comparison.impact_on_existing_learner: Current D. dubium accepted species name and authorship remain PASS. Generic circumscription is source-version dependent; do not force a new name, duplicate or rank change.
source_comparison.authority_update_status: UNRESOLVED until the backbone incorporates or explicitly rejects the 2026 revision; the primary study's taxonomic proposal is documented, not ignored.

handoff: No new card or name change. Keep accepted D. dubium species; retain Leptochloa dubia, Chloris dubia, Diplachne dubia aliases with authorship. The 2026 monotypic Disakisperma/Cypholepis revision is a taxonomy-source discrepancy for future authority synchronization, not a reason to rewrite the current learner or infer photo identity.

references.source: Peterson, Romaschenko, Snow & Herrera-Arrieta (2026), PhytoKeys 279:1–16, DOI 10.3897/phytokeys.279.203849
